findings: Analyzes the competing -26.0 and -27.7 kcal/mol molecular formation enthalpies; reaction analysis gives -26.05 +/-0.42 kcal/mol at 298 K.

findings: Paper states 1500 K line-list applicability and 18000 cm-1 state cutoff; PF deficit versus HITRAN grows at 3000 K.
Para and ortho symmetry weights are 1 and 3; remove total proton spin factor 4 for thermochemical comparison.

Empirical levels improve AYTY line positions; this does not independently demonstrate complete high-temperature thermodynamic sums.
